_about: Second set of on-screen hooks for the six Genjutsu Lite reels (26 Oct 2026). Yarin asked for funnier, more trendy hooks about the struggles of being a mom. Trend formats: 'אני: / גם אני:', 'POV', 'מי עוד', before and after kids. One line break = one beat. Same end CTA as captions.json. Lint: carousel/carousel-pipeline/scripts/voice_lint.py.
